meta_description: Bloom Gardening in Southville, Bristol. Professional garden design, maintenance and landscaping. Get a free quote today.
hero_eyebrow: Fully Insured & Experienced — Bristol's Local Gardeners
hero_subhead: From overgrown borders to beautiful outdoor spaces. Bloom Gardening brings your Bristol garden back to life.
services_subhead: Whether you need a tidy-up or a complete redesign, we handle every aspect of garden care and landscaping.

services.title: Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Weekly or fortnightly cuts, hedge trimming, weeding and seasonal care. We keep your garden looking immaculate all year round, tailored to your schedule.

services.title: Garden Design & Landscaping
services.desc: Create the outdoor space you've always wanted. From initial concept through to planting and paving, we design and build gardens that work for your lifestyle.

services.title: Lawn Care & Renovation
services.desc: Scarifying, aeration, seeding and expert feeding programmes. We transform patchy, tired lawns into lush green spaces that thrive.

services.title: Hedge & Tree Work
services.desc: Professional pruning, shaping and removal. Safe handling of established trees and hedges, with waste cleared and recycled where possible.

services.title: Spring & Autumn Clearance
services.desc: Deep cleans to refresh your borders and remove winter debris. We prepare your garden for the new season and cart away all waste responsibly.

services.title: Patio & Pathway Cleaning
services.desc: Jet-washing and algae removal that brings driveways, patios and steps back to life. We use gentle pressure to protect your surfaces.

about_pullquote: We treat every garden like it's our own—because your outdoor space matters.
about_para_1: Bloom Gardening was founded on the simple belief that everyone deserves a garden they love. Over 12 years, we've transformed over 500 Bristol gardens—from small urban courtyards to sprawling family spaces. We're fully insured, reliable, and proud to be a fixture in the Southville and wider Bristol community.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we listen first, work hard, and don't cut corners. Whether it's a one-off tidy or a complete redesign, we bring professionalism, creativity and genuine care to every job. You'll find us turning up on time, leaving your garden cleaner than we found it, and always ready to answer questions about plant care.
reviews_heading: What Bristol Gardeners Say About Bloom

reviews.text: We'd let our garden get completely out of hand during lockdown—it was a real eyesore. Dan and his team came round with a plan, and within a couple of visits it was unrecognisable. They even suggested some planting ideas that have really paid off. Couldn't be happier, will definitely use them again.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Bloom Gardening designed our entire back garden from scratch. They were really patient with us, walked through different options, and delivered something we absolutely love. The attention to detail is brilliant—they even built in a little raised bed area for the kids. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Sarah J.

reviews.text: Trustworthy lads. We've had them every other week for maintenance now and the garden has never looked better. They're punctual, professional, and fair on price. Nothing's too much trouble. That's rare these days.
reviews.author: Christopher M.
